relations: The shoreward swell steepens across open water, then breaks into white foam near the beach edge.
The sun's reflection shimmers and fractures continuously on the moving ripples of the calm sea.
The breaking foam band widens and creeps closer to the foreground as the swell reaches the shoreline.
The thin wash along the right beach recedes and re-forms with the shifting surf line.
caption: The video captures a seaside sunset, the sun low on the horizon just left of center, throwing a bright shimmering column across the calm sea. A dark headland topped by a pale building rises on the right, while a sloping sandy-pebbly beach fills the lower foreground and meets a gentle surf line. Layered gray clouds, tinted by the low light, stretch across an overcast sky, and the overall framing of sun and cliff holds steady throughout. A long, low swell moves shoreward, its dark trough and crest gradually steepening as it crosses the open water. The sun's reflection continuously shimmers and fractures into moving ripples on the surface. As the swell nears the beach, a band of white breaking foam forms and spreads diagonally across the lower shoreline. This foamy edge widens and creeps closer to the foreground. Meanwhile the thin wash along the right side of the beach recedes and re-forms with the shifting surf. Small surface ripples across the open water quietly reorganize.
